rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial pattern for adding a negative clause or repeating negatives in a neither...nor series.

example.english: I don’t feel like eating today, nor do I feel like cooking.
example.traditional: 我今日唔想食飯，又唔想煮飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 sik6 faan6 jau6 m4 soeng2 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use this when a preceding negative clause is already established, meaning also not or either not.

example.english: I don’t eat beef, nor do I eat chicken.
example.traditional: 我唔食牛肉，雞肉都唔食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 sik6 ngau4 juk6 gai1 juk6 dou1 m4 sik6

rows.note: Use this more formal alternative for an additional negative clause or for the later items in a neither...nor series.

example.english: This plan involves no private data, nor will it disclose any records.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃唔涉及私人資料，亦都唔會公開任何紀錄。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 sip3 kap6 si1 jan4 zi1 liu2 jik6 dou1 m4 wui5 gung1 hoi1 jam6 ho4 gei2 luk6
